description: Cast portraits: batch-generate candidates on the local GPU (script) → Creative Director picks winners (Opus) → owner gate.

stages.task: Mode B review for the studio cast. For each agent in .studio/roster.json (except owner), LOOK at its candidates in .studio/portraits/candidates/<id>_*.png. Pick the better one (on-model for the role, clean face and hands, no text or artifacts, consistent style with the rest of the cast) and copy it to .studio/portraits/<id>.png with node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('src','dst')". If both are bad, regenerate that character with node "{{soft}}/creative/portraits.js" --only <id> --seeds 4 and pick again. Write docs/creative/cast/review.md using the fixed per-asset format: Verdict (APPROVE/REDO), Chosen file (the candidate filename selected), What works, What doesn't (specific visible issues), Redo instruction (exact prompt change), Originality check.

stages.title: Cast portraits are live in the Control Room. Keep them?
